local.setIn: Set in Australia. All amounts are in Australian dollars.

high.label: Lavish wedding
high.diary: We had a lavish wedding. I'll never forget our guests' smiles.

mid.label: Standard wedding
mid.diary: We had a simple but heartfelt wedding.

low.label: Registry + backyard party
low.diary: We married at the registry office and threw a backyard barbie with friends.

wedding.skip: We skipped the ceremony and shared a quiet toast, just the two of us.

high.label: Europe
high.diary: Honeymoon in Europe. We walked cobblestone streets hand in hand.

mid.label: Bali
mid.diary: Honeymoon in Bali. The sunsets over the rice terraces were beautiful.

low.label: Coastal road trip
low.diary: Our honeymoon was a road trip along the Great Ocean Road.

honeymoon.skip: We skipped the honeymoon. "Someday," we promised.

high.diary: We decided we'd both work full-time.

mid.diary: My partner switched to shorter hours / part-time.

low.diary: My partner left work to focus on home.

high.label: Luxury car
high.diary: We bought a luxury car. Driving it makes us sit up straight.

mid.label: New car
mid.diary: We bought a new car. Weekend drives became our joy.

low.label: Used car
low.diary: We bought a used car. A bit old, but it runs fine.

car.skip: We didn't buy a car. Public transport and the odd rideshare will do.
car.never: We decided to live without a car.

high.label: Nanny + private childcare
high.diary: We hired a nanny, then moved to a boutique childcare centre.

mid.label: Long day care
mid.diary: We found a spot at a long day care centre near home.

low.label: Grandparents
low.diary: The grandparents will look after them. They're thrilled.

high.label: Independent school
high.diary: Started at an independent school. The blazer looks great.

mid.label: Catholic school
mid.diary: Started at the local Catholic primary school.

low.label: Public school
low.diary: Started at the public primary school. The school bag looks huge.

high.label: Independent school
high.diary: Moved up to the independent school's secondary campus.

mid.label: Catholic school
mid.diary: Started high school at a Catholic college.

low.label: Public school
low.diary: Started high school at the public school. Totally into footy.

high.label: Independent school
high.diary: Started senior years at the independent school.

mid.label: Catholic school + tutoring
mid.diary: Started senior years at the Catholic college, with tutoring for the ATAR.

low.label: Public school
low.diary: Started senior years at the public school.

high.label: Uni interstate, college
high.diary: Went to uni interstate and moved into a residential college. ({years} yrs)

mid.label: Uni from home
mid.diary: Went to uni in town, living at home. HECS covers the fees for now. ({years} yrs)

low.label: TAFE, then uni
low.diary: Did a TAFE diploma first, then moved on to uni. ({years} yrs)

university.skip: Started an apprenticeship after Year 12. A working adult now.

high.label: House on a big block
high.diary: We bought a house on a big block. We talked over the floor plan again and again.

mid.label: Townhouse
mid.diary: We bought a townhouse. Our own courtyard at last.

low.label: Older house + renovation
low.diary: We bought an older house and renovated it. Old, but full of charm.

house.skip: We didn't buy; we rented a bigger place.
house.never: We decided to rent for life. Travelling light is best.
house.majorRepair: The old house's roof and plumbing gave out. Major renovation cost {cost:money}.

high.label: Full renovation
high.diary: We renovated the whole house. That'll hold for a while.

low.label: Quick fix
low.diary: We patched it up for now.

high.label: Trip abroad
high.diary: We took a family trip abroad.

mid.label: Holiday on the coast
mid.diary: We took a family holiday on the Sunshine Coast.

low.label: Camping trip
low.diary: We went camping at the national park. Still fun.

familyTrip.skip: We spent this year's anniversary relaxing at home.

S.comment: No more money worries. Let's go wherever we always wanted, whenever we like.

A.comment: Hobbies and travel to enjoy. We can laugh and say, "We did well."

B.comment: No luxuries, but no troubles either. Calm days go on.

C.comment: Super and the Age Pension feel thin. We'll get by together, saving where we can.

D.comment: We'll keep working a while. While we're able, that's not so bad.

bankrupt.comment: Debts piled up and our finances collapsed. Look back at where we overreached, and try again.
